version.changelog:
p-video-animate 1.0.8

- Added guidance to open `generation-diversity` clarification intake before the first POST in the agent habit section.
- Minor clarifications in agent workflow for required input gathering.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Pruna video-generation helper that uploads user-provided media to Pruna to animate a still image from a reference video.

dimensions.detail: Network access, PRUNA_API_KEY use, and uploading source video/reference image are expected for this API integration and are described in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It recommends installing related Pruna skills via npx from PrunaAI/pruna-skills, including an optional full-suite install; this is disclosed but users should recognize it adds more skill behavior beyond this file.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require confirming the API key and user inputs before the first POST, and they disclose the image/video roles and paid API generation flow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains no executable scripts, background workers, persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, deletion, or unrelated local file access instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: it collects an image and source video, optionally drafts a narrow motion prompt, and calls the Pruna p-video-animate API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure you are comfortable uploading the selected image, video, and possibly audio to Pruna, using a paid API key, and installing the referenced prerequisite skills. Use media and likenesses you have rights to, and treat the optional disable_safety_checker field as a setting that should only be used deliberately.
